YY Shape this—a delicate “Y” shape that adds drama without overpowering. Our YY lashes consist of four flat premade fans, meticulously crafted to achieve that signature “YY” silhouette. The result? A harmonious blend of classic elegance and voluminous allure.
The Best of Both Worlds: YY lashes bridge the gap between classic and volume extensions. They offer the density of volume fans while retaining the grace of individual classics. Say goodbye to compromise—our YY extensions give you the best of both worlds.
 Softness and Comfort: Made from premium Korean PBT fiber, our YY lashes are as soft as a gentle breeze. Clients will adore the natural look and lightweight feel. No more heavy, uncomfortable extensions—just pure lash bliss.

Fluffiness Galore: Want lashes that defy gravity? YY extensions create a fluffier, softer effect, adding volume to your real lashes. Whether your clients desire a subtle enhancement or full-on drama, YY lashes deliver.

Greater Retention: Unlike fleeting romances, our YY lashes stick around. Expect them to last 6 to 8 weeks on your clients’ eyelids. With proper care, they might even extend their stay. It’s like a lash vacation that never ends!

Application Made Easy: Applying YY lashes is a breeze. Use tweezers to pick up the lashes in the middle, maintaining their integrity before the lash base splits into that iconic “YY” shape. No mess, no fuss—just precision.

 Versatility Unleashed: Whether you’re a seasoned pro or a lash enthusiast, YY extensions fit seamlessly into your repertoire. They’re the secret sauce for achieving that coveted 3D effect.
How to Use YY Lashes:

Prep: Ensure your client’s natural lashes are clean and dry.
Pick Up: Use tweezers to grab the YY lashes between the top and bottom of the lash extensions.
Apply: Attach the YY-shaped extensions to the natural lashes using your preferred technique.
Admire: Step back and admire the transformation!

Question:
Why update the packaging?
Answer:
In the past, the quality of the packaging shell was poor, and many customers received damaged shells with eyelashes flying everywhere. There were also problems with the glue not sticking enough and not lasting
Question:
What are the upgrades for the new packaging?
Answer:
1. The newly packaged shell is more sturdy and the weight has been upgraded from 60g to 80g. It cannot be broken and the false eyelashes will not stick to the lid.
2. The bottom adhesive strip is a straight line, and there will be no intermittent glue phenomenon, making it more adhesive than before.
3. The quality of the false eyelashes inside is better, they won't be messy, and the length and style are the same as before, very beautiful!
Description:
Name: False Eyelashes
Material: Man-made Fiber
Applicable People: General Population
Style: Simple
Features:
1. Made Of Synthetic Rubber, Used For The Stem Of False Eyelashes.
2. The Adhesive Strip Is Fully Bonded To The Stem Of The False Eyelashes, Making The False Eyelashes Reusable.
3. Different Pasting Methods, Different Effects.
4. The Adhesive Strip Is Stable Once Applied, Has Strong Adhesion And Will Not Fall Off For A Long Time.
5. Easy To Replace, Anyone With Hands Can Do It.
6. A Variety Of Shapes To Choose From, Jelly Texture, Whatever You Want.
Package Included:
1 Plate* (1 False Eyelash)
